reproduce_selected_read: For each manifest entry, read app_root/path and compare SHA-256 and byte count. For each main_binary_strings entry, read MacOS/Microsoft Outlook at offset_hex and compare UTF-8 text bytes. Parse the recorded plist/JSON resources and compare the captured values. Use strings -a -t x -arch all for an independent printable-string pass. Short fields such as to/cc/end require strings -n 2. No app execution is needed.
registration_projection: Info.plist snapshots retain URL, Service, activity, and extension declarations. Document type arrays retain mail/calendar/contact types only; unrelated Office document types are omitted. Original files are hash-bound in the manifest.
